tests.title: Checkout drops a promotion code that became invalid after it was applied
tests.goal: The checkout never shows a discount the order cannot get.
preconditions: Member logged in; a CRM single-use code (storeberry-crm SCRM-108) applied at /checkout

steps.text: Revoke the code in the CRM
Fill the rest and Proceed to checkout, then close the warning

expected.text: Step 2 or 3 removes the code and shows the total without it
The message names the code that was removed

checks.label: Step 2 or 3 removes the code and shows the total without it
The message names the code that was removed

notes: QBgH2nw9: after revoke and shipping change still Applied, HKD 459.00; Proceed -> "Invalid promotion code."; after OK unchanged until reload.

tests.title: My Account > My Promotion Codes lists the codes assigned to the member
tests.goal: Members can find the promotion codes the shop gave them.
preconditions: A member with at least one code assigned in the CRM (storeberry-crm SCRM-109)

steps.text: Log in, open My Account, click My Promotion Codes

expected.text: The page loads (no 404) and lists each assigned code with its promotion and validity
Used codes are marked as used

checks.label: The page loads (no 404) and lists each assigned code with its promotion and validity
Used codes are marked as used

notes: Member MEMy001164526 with 2 assigned codes: /my-account/promotion-codes -> 404 Page Not Found (menu link and direct URL).
Exploration 2026-10-28: promo codes at checkout, member promotion codes page.
